meta.title: Privacy policy - Cosmic Studio
meta.description: How Cosmic Studio handles personal data: forms, call booking, emails, audience measurement, retention periods and your rights.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This page explains how Cosmic Studio handles the personal data collected on this website and in email exchanges.
privacy.legalNoticePrefix: For publisher and hosting details, see the

sections.title: Data controller
body: The data controller is Cosmic Studio, represented by Matthieu Compérat. For any request about your personal data, write to support@gocosmic.dev.

sections.title: Data collected
body: The website has no customer account, payment, CAPTCHA or advertising pixel. Two forms are handled on the server. The free mockup page collects your email address, the colour mood you pick, the address of your current website if you provide it, your message and the language of the page. If you arrive from the pricing simulator, the request also includes the choices you made there (project type, site type, number of pages, selected options, update frequency and the resulting estimated monthly price), so the studio can reply with the full picture. The contact form collects your name, email address and message, plus your phone number, your business and the kind of need you picked, if you fill them in. In both cases, the information is sent by email to the studio's mailbox and nothing is stored in a database. Messages sent through the site's email links are handled by your email software and the recipient's mailbox.

Your IP address is processed temporarily by the hosting provider's firewall, which limits each of the two forms (contact and free mockup) to three submissions every ten minutes, alongside a hidden anti-spam field. The hosting provider may also process technical data for its security and delivery logs. Vercel Analytics is only loaded after your consent, to count page views.

If you book a call from the contact page, Google Calendar passes the studio your name, email address, the chosen time slot and any information you enter in the booking form. This information is kept in the studio's calendar, not in a database.

Three items are stored in your browser. The pricing simulation is kept only so it can follow you from the simulator to the free mockup form: it is sent to us only if you submit that form, is erased once the request is sent, and disappears when you close the tab. The dates of your recent contact form submissions are used to limit how often the form can be sent from the same browser and stay there until you clear your browser data; they are never sent to us. Your choice of light or dark theme is kept so the site opens the way you left it; it is never sent to us.

sections.title: Purposes and legal bases
body: Emails are processed to answer requests, prepare quotes, provide support and keep a record of exchanges. This processing is based on legitimate interest and, where applicable, on pre-contractual steps taken at your request. Free mockup requests are processed to prepare the mockup, send it to you and reply to you.

Messages sent through the contact form are processed for the same purposes. Limiting submissions per IP address and filtering automated submissions rely on the legitimate interest in protecting the service from abuse.
Information submitted when booking a call is processed to organise the call and follow it up, based on pre-contractual steps taken at your request.

Audience measurement is used to understand overall traffic and improve the website. Cosmic Studio only loads Vercel Analytics after your consent. Security logs rely on the legitimate interest in protecting the service.

sections.title: Recipients and processors
body: Data may be accessed by Cosmic Studio, its email provider, Resend (which delivers the emails from the contact form and the free mockup requests) and Vercel, for hosting and audience measurement. LinkedIn is an external website that may process data under its own policy if you follow a link to it.

If you choose to book a call from the contact page, Google (Google Calendar) hosts the studio's booking calendar and processes the information you enter for its own purposes under its own privacy policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy.

sections.title: Retention periods
body: Email exchanges are kept for as long as needed to handle your request and follow it up, then archived or deleted according to legal, accounting or litigation requirements. Your audience measurement choice is stored in your browser until you clear its data or switch browsers. Hosting logs follow the hosting provider's configuration.

Contact form submissions are not stored in a database: they are sent by email, and the exchange that follows is kept as described above. Bookings made through Google Calendar are kept in the studio's calendar for as long as needed to follow up the request, on the same basis.

sections.title: International transfers
body: Some processors, including Vercel, email providers and Google (Google Calendar), may process data outside the European Economic Area.

These transfers are framed by Standard Contractual Clauses approved by the European Commission and, for Google, by the EU-US Data Privacy Framework. For questions about the applicable safeguards, contact support@gocosmic.dev.

sections.title: Your rights
body: Where these rights apply, you can ask to access, correct or erase your data, restrict or object to its processing, or receive it in a portable format, by writing to support@gocosmic.dev. You can also lodge a complaint with the CNIL: https://www.cnil.fr/.

sections.title: Cookies and audience measurement
body: Cosmic Studio does not load any advertising cookies. Vercel Analytics is treated as a non-essential audience measurement tool and is only loaded after your consent.
You can change or withdraw your consent at any time with the cookie settings button at the bottom of every page.

The Google Calendar booking calendar on the contact page only loads if you click “Show the calendar”; Google may then set its own cookies. Without that click, nothing is loaded from Google, and you can open the booking page in a new tab instead.

terms.title: Terms of sale
terms.intro: These terms of sale apply to the subscription and services offered by Cosmic Studio on www.gocosmic.dev.

sections.title: Provider
body: The provider is Cosmic Studio, represented by Matthieu Compérat, sole trader (Entreprise individuelle) registered since 17 October 2016 (SIRET 823 200 365 00026), 485 route de la champanaise, 74410 Duingt, France. Contact: support@gocosmic.dev.

sections.title: Free mockup
body: The mockup and the review of your current website are free and commit you to nothing. They are prepared from the information you send us.

sections.title: Subscribing
body: The subscription is confirmed in writing after a first conversation, once your needs (pages, options, changes) have been defined together. It takes effect when the site goes live.

sections.title: Price and billing
body: Subscription prices are those shown on the Services & pricing page at the time of subscription, based on the options chosen. Billing is monthly, quarterly or annual, whichever you prefer.
Guidance, team reinforcement and custom projects are billed at the day rate or on a quote, provided before any work starts.

sections.title: Duration and commitment
body: The subscription has no minimum term and can be cancelled every month, as long as it does not include domain name or email management.
As soon as either of these two options is active, the subscription runs in 12-month periods, renewed automatically, to cover the registration of the domain name and the email address.

sections.title: Options
body: You can add an option at any time; it takes effect from the next billing period.

The number of pages, the domain name, Swiss hosting and the email address cannot be removed once active, because each one is a commitment made on your behalf (pages built, domain registered, mailbox opened). Only the frequency of content changes can be adjusted up or down.

sections.title: Cancellation
body: You can cancel at any time in writing. The site stays online until the end of the current paid period (end of the month for a subscription with no minimum term, end of the current 12-month period if it includes a domain name or an email address).
You leave with your content and your domain name.

sections.title: Ownership
body: Your texts, images and domain name belong to you from day one. The site's code is transferred to you free of charge after 36 months of subscription. Before then, it can be transferred for a fee that depends on the remaining time.
For a one-off project, the code belongs to you from delivery.

sections.title: Your commitments
body: You provide the texts, images and information needed to build or update the site. Announced timelines start once we have received them.

sections.title: Liability and availability
body: Cosmic Studio takes reasonable steps to keep the site available, without being able to guarantee that it will never be interrupted. If a prolonged outage is caused by Cosmic Studio, the period concerned may be extended by the same length of time.

sections.title: Personal data
body: The processing of personal data is described in the privacy policy.

sections.title: Governing law and disputes
body: These terms are governed by French law. In the event of a dispute, an amicable solution is sought before any legal action; failing that, the competent courts are those of Cosmic Studio's registered address.
